data.gender_notes: Ainsworth is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ainsworth is a classic English name, derived from the Old English words ‘ægnes’ meaning ‘little’ and ‘worth’ meaning ‘man’ or ‘fortress’. This name can be interpreted as ‘little man’ or ‘man’s fortress’. Ainsworth is a strong and noble name, evoking images of protection, strength, and courage. The name Ainsworth carries the meaning “Little one, or man's fortress” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ainsworth usually hope their child will grow to embody little one, or man's fortress and live with faith, good character and purpose.
